title: Rabbi Chana bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, end of Shabbat, chapter 4: Rabbi Yochanan, Rabbi Yonatan and Rabbi Chana bar Abba all hold one view. But Korban HaEdah’s reading there is Rabbi Abba bar Chana. Hyman considers it more likely that the reading should be Rabbi Chanan bar Abba; see his entry.

notes.text: The Guggenheimer edition of Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2 groups Rav Chana bar Abba with Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yonatan. Abba bar Chana appears separately earlier in the passage. The Korban HaEdah variant and the proposed Chanan reading are Hyman’s reports.
